```c
/*******************************************************************************
* Instrument: SESANS_test
*
* A SESANS (Spin-Echo Small-Angle Neutron Scattering) test instrument built
* from a monochromatic polarised source, three Foil_flipper_magnet spin-echo
* elements, a SANS_spheres2 sample, and two analyser/detector arms used to
* reconstruct the polarisation (spin-echo signal) after the sample.
*******************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT SESANS_test(L0=2.165, DL=0.02, By=0.00468)

DECLARE
%{
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT src = Source_simple(
    yheight=0.01, xwidth=0.01, dist=2.25,
    focus_xw=0.01, focus_yh=0.01,
    lambda0=L0, dlambda=DL, gauss=1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE origin
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT set_pol = Set_pol(px=1)
AT (0, 0, 0.1) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT px1 = PolLambda_monitor(
    nL=501, restore_neutron=1, filename="pxAfterAnalyser",
    mx=1, Lmin=L0-DL, Lmax=L0+DL)
AT (0, 0, 0.01) RELATIVE set_pol
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT f1 = Foil_flipper_magnet(
    xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.1, zdepth=0.3, phi=0.095993,
    foilthick=3.0, Bx=0, By=By, Bz=0, foil_in=1, verbose=0)
AT (0, 0, 0.5) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT px2 = PolLambda_monitor(
    nL=501, restore_neutron=1, filename="pxAfterAnalyser",
    mx=1, Lmin=L0-DL, Lmax=L0+DL)
AT (0, 0, 0.16) RELATIVE f1
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT f2 = Foil_flipper_magnet(
    xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.1, zdepth=0.3, phi=0.095993,
    foilthick=3.0, Bx=0, By=By, Bz=0, foil_in=1, verbose=0)
AT (0, 0, 2.0) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT px3 = PolLambda_monitor(
    nL=501, restore_neutron=1, filename="pxAfterAnalyser",
    mx=1, Lmin=L0-DL, Lmax=L0+DL)
AT (0, 0, 0.16) RELATIVE f2
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT sans_spheres = SANS_spheres2(
    xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.02, zthick=0.001,
    dsdw_inc=0.0, sc_aim=0.8, sans_aim=0.95,
    R=10000, phi=0.015, singlesp=0,
    Qmind=0.00003, Qmaxd=0.001)
WHEN (1==1)
AT (0, 0, 2.25) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT f3 = Foil_flipper_magnet(
    xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.1, zdepth=0.3, phi=0.095993,
    foilthick=3.0, Bx=0, By=By, Bz=0, foil_in=1, verbose=0)
AT (0, 0, 2.5) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT f4 = Foil_flipper_magnet(
    xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.1, zdepth=0.3, phi=0.095993,
    foilthick=3.0, Bx=0, By=By, Bz=0, foil_in=1, verbose=0)
AT (0, 0, 4.0) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT px6 = PolLambda_monitor(
    nL=501, restore_neutron=1, filename="pxAfterAnalyser",
    mx=1, Lmin=L0-DL, Lmax=L0+DL)
AT (0, 0, 0.16) RELATIVE f4
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT ana = PolAnalyser_ideal(mx=1)
AT (0, 0, 4.4) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT det = PSD_monitor(
    nx=101, ny=101, filename="det",
    xwidth=0.011, yheight=0.011)
AT (0, 0, 4.5) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT trick = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 4.4) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE
EXTEND %{
  RESTORE_NEUTRON(INDEX_CURRENT_COMP-2,x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,t,sx,sy,sz,p);
%}

COMPONENT ana2 = PolAnalyser_ideal(mx=-1)
AT (0, 0, 4.4) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT det2 = PSD_monitor(
    nx=101, ny=101, filename="det2",
    xwidth=0.011, yheight=0.011)
AT (0, 0, 4.5) RELATIVE src
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

FINALLY
%{
%}

END
```
